Road near Ferry Road at about 6 p.m. April 2nd, 1932 on a

The following is the statement of Yien Tsoong( 宗 ),

Yien Tsoong, age 25, native of Kaifeng, Honan, S/Student, re-
siding at 522 Sun Sun Lee, Connaught Road.
In July 19th Year of Chinese Republic, I came to Shanghai from
Kaifeng, and studied in China University, Woosung. At the
begining of February, 1932, I came to Shanghai and stayed with
my friend named Liang Tien Ngoo( 梁天牛 ) in the Modern
Middle School, 47 Markham Road, and at the same time asked him
to get some job for me. At the middle of March, 1932, this
school removed to Ave. Haig, where a 'Union of Students Suffering
from War District' was then organized. I took abode there.
On the 31/3/32, I heard that this school was going to stop, so
I removed out and stayed with my friend named Tsang Ts Chung
( 張致中 ), a student of Chi Nan University, in Sun Sun
Lee Alleyway, in an upstairs back room. At about 5.30 p.m.
2/4/32, I came out from my home, and intended to go to Koh
Hwa Middle School, Robison Road, to see a friend named Hur Ming
San. Whilst I was on my way on Gordon Road near Haiphong Road,
I met my former school mate of China University named Cheng
Suh Ying( 鄭淑 ), female, and talked with her. She said
would
to me that at the evening she has a very important matter to
consult with me and asked me to go first and wait her at the
corner of Ferry Road as she would change her clothing. Then
she gave me 1 $5. note and a parcel of paper which I did not
open at that time and ask her what was the content? When I
went 200 yds. West, I was arrested by Police and the contents
are communistic documents. I have 1 box left in Modern Middle
School. When I was in this school, I liked to hear speeches

Charge Offence against the Internal Security of State, cont to art. 2
Sec. 2 and art. 6 of the Law governing punishment of persons
who commit acts with intent to injure the Republic of China.
For that he at about 6 p.m. on the 3/4/32 on Haiphong Road
near Perry Road was found to be in possession of certain lit-
erature to it:- Enrolment forms for the Communist Party.

Proceedings Mr Lee appeared for the police.
Mr Lee:- The accused was arrested at about 6pm on the 3/4/32
on the Haiphong Road by a police search party and at the time of
arrest the accused had in his possession a number of Communistic
pamphlets.
C.S.90:- Corroborated and added, At the station the accused
stated that he lived at No.522 Connaught Road to which house I
went and was told that the man was unknown there. The accused then
stated that his girl friend one named 'Tsung Suh Ying' had given
the pamphlets to him and asked him to wait for her while she went
to change her dress. The accused states that while he was so waiting
the police came and he was arrested. The accused states that he do-
es not know the address of the girl so implicated by him. I wish to
bring to the notice of the Your that this accused had a friend one
named 'Liang Tien Woo' and that this man was arrested also for the
same offence as this accused. Will the Court ask the accused if this
is a true statement. ?
Accused in reply to the Judge:- That is so . I was a Student
at the Woosung Middle school, and had to go away from there on account
of the war. I live in the Sun San Li off the Connaught Road since
the 31/3/32. I and the man 'Tsung' live in the same room. He also is
a student. A friend named 'Chen' told me to go and live there as I
had no money to live any other place. I took only my bed there. At
the time of my arrest the pamphlets were in my possession. The girl
gave them to me to hold for her while she went in to change her dress
I did not then know the contents of the parcel. I am not a member of
any party. While at the School I did join the Koumintang in the 17th
year of the Republic of China. I do not now belong to any party. I
have never been a member of any communistic party.

指控 违反《危害民国紧急治罪法》第二条第二款及第六条，犯有意图危害中华民国之行为罪。
事由：1932年4月3日下午6时许，在海防路（Haiphong Road）靠近贝勒路（Perry Road）处，被发现持有若干文献，即：共产党入党登记表。

诉讼过程 李律师代表警方出庭。
李律师：被告于1932年4月3日下午6时许在海防路被警方搜查队逮捕，逮捕时被告身上藏有若干共产主义小册子。
C.S.90号警员：予以佐证并补充称，在警局内，被告声称其居住在康纳路（Connaught Road）522号，我前往该处，被告知不认识此人。被告随后称，其女友一名叫“Tsung Suh Ying”（音译）的女子将小册子交给他，并让他等候，她去换衣服。被告称，在他等候期间，警察到来并将其逮捕。被告称他不知道这位受其牵连的女子的地址。我想提请法庭注意，这名被告有一位名叫“Liang Tien Woo”（音译）的朋友，此人亦因与被告相同的罪名被捕。请法庭询问被告此陈述是否属实？

被告回答法官提问：确有其事。我曾是吴淞中学的学生，因战事不得不离开该校。自1932年3月31日起，我居住在康纳路附近的孙三利（Sun San Li，音译）。我和名为“Tsung”（音译）的人住在同一房间。他也是学生。一位姓“陈”的朋友告诉我住到那里去，因为我没钱住别的地方。我只带了我的床铺去那里。被捕时，小册子在我身上。那女孩让我在她进去换衣服时代为保管。我当时并不知道包裹里的内容。我不是任何党派的成员。在校期间，我曾在民国十七年加入国民党。我现在不属于任何党派。我从未加入过任何共产主义政党。

诉讼过程。李律师代表警方出庭。
Y. T. Van 先生代表被告出庭。
被告：我不知道门牌号码，因为我在被捕前只在那里住了两天。但我确实和朋友一起住在康纳路。
法官问被告：你给了警方错误的地址。
被告：我没有。占用该房屋的名为“Tang”（音译）的男子害怕让警方知道我住在那里。
李律师：被告被控违反《危害民国紧急治罪法》第二条及第六条。
向法庭概述案情：被告由外巡捕 Weeks 在海防路（Baiphong Road，原文拼写错误，应为Haiphong）与斐伦路（Ferry Rd）转角处逮捕，逮捕时被告身上藏有若干张空白的共产党人员入党登记表。当搜查队讯问时，被告称这些表格是一位女性朋友交给他的，他当时正在等候她。后来被告向警方提供了康纳路的一个地址，警方遂将被告带往该处。屋内住户未能指认被告，且该房屋的主要租客称此人此前从未到过该处。
外巡捕 Weeks：佐证李律师的说法，并回答主审法官补充道：逮捕时，被告身上持有的入党登记表不止现在法庭手中的这两张。警方仅将其中两张作为持有证据送交法庭。
C.D.S. 90号警员：逮捕后，被告被带到警局，我讯问其居住地址，他称住在康纳路522号，随即将其带往该处。在该地址，住户称不认识被告。被告称他住在楼上的后间，我们随即带他去那里。在该房间，我们遇到三名学生，他们称不认识被告。随后被告被带去见主要租客，该租客称以前从未见过被告。在
